title: MISO MINN.HUB: hours with a negative real-time price
subtitle: Hours per month whose mean real-time price was below zero, 2026-09 to 2026-09
source_line: Source: CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, SPP via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table iso_rtm_hub_prices; data retrieved to 2026-10-04.
citations: California Independent System Operator (CAISO). PRC_INTVL_LMP: OASIS Interval Locational Marginal Prices, real-time dispatch (RTD, 5-minute). https://oasis.caiso.com/mrioasis/logon.do. Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT). NP6-905-CD: Settlement Point Prices at Resource Nodes, Hubs and Load Zones. https://www.ercot.com/mp/data-products/data-product-details?id=NP6-905-CD. facts: MISO MINN.HUB: 4 hours had a negative real-time price in 2026-09, the most of the months 2026-09 to 2026-09.
